title: Standardize icon-button tooltip coverage across primary workbenches
description:
Problem: the live UI audit found several icon-only controls with accessible labels but no visible tooltip affordance, which is inconsistent with MemorySmith's control style and makes toolbar actions harder to learn. Examples include Pages `New`, `Edit`, and `Delete`; Memories `Copy content`, `Copy agent context`, `Edit`, `Increment usage`, and `Delete`; Chat `Refresh models` and `Toggle sidebar`; and Admin tab scroll buttons.

Desired outcome: icon-only buttons across the main workbenches consistently expose both an accessible name and a hover/focus tooltip.

Scope:
- In scope: Pages, Memories, Chat, Admin tab-scroll controls, and any shared icon-button helper/component discovered while implementing.
- Out of scope: changing button icons, changing command behavior, or converting text buttons to icons.

Acceptance criteria:
- Every icon-only command in the audited route headers/toolbars has a stable accessible name.
- Every non-trivial icon-only command has a MudTooltip/title consistent with the visible command name.
- Disabled icon buttons still expose their purpose to assistive technology.
- Common toolbar patterns prefer a shared wrapper/helper where the existing component structure allows it.

Validation:
- Re-run the browser audit over `/pages`, `/memories`, `/chat`, and `/admin` and confirm no actionable icon-only toolbar controls are missing tooltip/name coverage.
- Run route-smoke or focused component/browser tests for the affected routes.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Created from 2026-05-25 live browser audit: multiple icon-only toolbar buttons had aria labels but no tooltip/title, while nearby controls such as Pages focus reading already use tooltips.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Implemented native `title` coverage for audited icon-only controls across Pages, Memories, Chat, and Admin-owned toolbar/panel actions while preserving existing `MudTooltip` wrappers and command behavior. Covered examples include Pages New/Edit/Delete and markdown toolbar controls, Memories copy/context/edit/usage/delete plus search/navigation/pagination/tag controls, Chat model/sidebar/history/composer/trace filter controls, and Admin model/variable action buttons. Admin tab scroll buttons are MudBlazor-generated chrome rather than app-owned `MudIconButton` markup in `Admin.razor`; this checkpoint covers the Admin icon actions the app owns. Validation: `dotnet build .\MemorySmith.App\MemorySmith.App.csproj --nologo` succeeded; `MEMORYSMITH_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5099 npm run test:route-smoke` passed 5/5; a multiline static sweep found no `MudIconButton` with `aria-label` but missing native `title` in Pages, MemoryViewer, Chat, or Admin.
